text:
maria: Heads-up — the Rust quickstart auth snippet is broken for new users. It shows
`ApiKey::new(\"YOUR_KEY\")` which is from an old helper; current SDK expects `Environment::from_env()` or `RedwoodAuth::from_env()`. New users copy/paste and get 401s.

devon: ugh, saw a support ticket for this this morning. can you paste the failing snippet + error?

maria: sure — in the README we currently have:
```rust
let client = RedwoodClient::new(ApiKey::new(\"YOUR_KEY\"));
let resp = client.generate(...).await?;
```
Error: `Err(Error::Authentication(\"missing credentials\"))` then a 401 from the API.

sam: quick repro: if you don't set REDWOOD_API_KEY env var it fails. the README doesn't call out env var at top like other langs.

chris: i can fix copy in the README. suggested replacement? Keep it short and mention `export REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

maria: propose replacing with this minimal example and a note:
```rust
// set env or use your secret manager
// $ export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
let auth = RedwoodAuth::from_env()?;
let client = RedwoodClient::new(auth);
let resp = client.text_generate(\"Hello world\").await?;
println!(\"{}\", resp.text);
```
Also add a one-line heading: "Authentication — set REDWOOD_API_KEY or configure RedwoodAuth".

devon: also add a tiny line about `RUST_LOG=debug` to help users see the auth header being set. saved us a support ticket last week.

sam: i'll open a PR with the snippet and a test that runs the examples (mocked) in CI so we catch drift. can we add an examples smoke test job that just checks snippets compile?

chris: yes please. add a cargo check step in .github/workflows/examples.yml and mark the job optional for now.

maria: one more: docs-bot, can you scan for other Rust snippets that still use `ApiKey::new`?

docs-bot: scanning repo... found 3 files: `docs/quickstarts/rust.md`, `examples/chat-rust/README.md`, `sdk/rust/README.md`. I'll add comments on the PRs.

devon: thanks — tagging @eng-ml for visibility in case any runtime behavior changed. chris, sam — ping when PR is up and i'll review. :thumbsup:

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/abc123 (adds env note + new snippet + github action step).

chris: reviewed, left one nit about wording. otherwise looks good.

maria: great, once merged i'll update the quickstart on the website and add a small blurb to the onboarding checklist so support can point to it.

devon: can we also add a short line in the SDK changelog about auth api change so people searching changelog find it?

maria: yes — added to the PR description. thanks everyone! :tada:
